description_en: Queries information about an ApsaraDB MyBase dedicated cluster
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-dedicated-host-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dedicated-host-group-id dhg-7a9xxxxxxxx --image-category WindowsWithMssqlStdLicense --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDedicatedHostGroups

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The image based on which the hosts in the dedicated clusters are created. Valid values:

WindowsWithMssqlStdLicense: a Windows image that contains the licenses of SQL Server Standard Edition
WindowsWithMssqlEntLisence: a Windows image that contains the licenses of SQL Server Enterprise Edition
WindowsWithMssqlWebLisence: a Windows image that contains the licenses of SQL Server Web Edition
AliLinux: a Linux image
parameters.help_zh:
根据主机镜像查询专属集群。取值：
WindowsWithMssqlStdLicense：Windows（含SQL Server标准版License）。
WindowsWithMssqlEntLisence：Windows（含SQL Server企业版License）。
WindowsWithMssqlWebLisence：Windows（含SQL ServerWeb版License）。
AliLinux：Linux
parameters.name: image_category

DedicatedHostGroups.description_en: The information about dedicated clusters returned

items.description_zh: 集群信息列表详情如下

AllocationPolicy.description_en:
The policy based on which the system allocates resources in the dedicated cluster. Valid values:

Evenly: The system evenly allocates the resources to all the hosts in the dedicated cluster.
Intensively: The system preferentially allocates the resources to the heavily loaded hosts in the dedicated cluster
AllocationPolicy.description_zh:
当前专属集群的资源调度的分配策略。返回值：
Evenly：均衡分配
Intensively：紧凑分配

BastionInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the bastion host

CpuAllocateRation.description_en: The percentage of allocated cores in the dedicated cluster. Unit: %
CpuAllocateRation.description_zh: 当前专属集群已分配CPU的比例。单位：百分号（%）

CpuAllocatedAmount.description_en: The number of allocated cores in the dedicated cluster
CpuAllocatedAmount.description_zh: 当前专属集群已分配CPU的个数

CpuAllocationRatio.description_en: The core overcommitment ratio of the dedicated cluster. Unit: %. For more information about the core overcommitment ratio, see [Manage a dedicated cluster]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/182328.html）
CpuAllocationRatio.description_zh: 当前专属集群的CPU超配比。单位：百分号（%）。关于超配比的更多信息，请参见[管理集群]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/182328.html）

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the dedicated cluster was created
CreateTime.description_zh: 当前专属集群创建时间的时间戳

DedicatedHostCountGroupByHostType.description_en:
The type of storage media that is used for the hosts in the dedicated cluster. Valid values:

dhg_cloud_ssd: cloud disks
dhg_local_ssd: local disks
DedicatedHostCountGroupByHostType.description_zh:
当前专属集群里的主机存储类型。取值：
dhg_cloud_ssd：云盘
dhg_local_ssd：本地盘

DedicatedHostGroupDesc.description_en: The name of the dedicated cluster

DedicatedHostGroupId.description_en: The ID of the dedicated cluster

DiskAllocateRation.description_en: The percentage of allocated disk space in the dedicated cluster. Unit: %
DiskAllocateRation.description_zh: 当前专属集群已分配的磁盘比例。单位：百分号（%）

DiskAllocatedAmount.description_en: The amount of allocated disk space in the dedicated cluster. Unit: GB
DiskAllocatedAmount.description_zh: 当前专属集群中已分配的磁盘容量。单位：GB

DiskAllocationRatio.description_en: The disk overcommitment ratio of the dedicated cluster. Unit: %. For more information about the core overcommitment ratio, see [Manage a dedicated cluster]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/182328.html）
DiskAllocationRatio.description_zh: 当前专属集群的磁盘空间超配比。单位：%。关于超配比的更多信息，请参见[管理集群]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/182328.html）

DiskUsedAmount.description_en: The amount of used disk space in the dedicated cluster. Unit: GB
DiskUsedAmount.description_zh: 当前专属集群的已使用磁盘容量。单位：GB

DiskUtility.description_en: The disk usage of the dedicated cluster. Unit: %
DiskUtility.description_zh: 当前专属集群的磁盘利用率。单位：百分号（%）

Engine.description_en: The database engine of the instances in the dedicated cluster
Engine.description_zh: 当前专属集群的数据库引擎

HostNumber.description_en: The total number of hosts in the dedicated cluster
HostNumber.description_zh: 当前专属集群中主机的总个数

HostReplacePolicy.description_en:
The policy that is used to handle host failures. Valid values:

Auto: The system automatically replaces faulty hosts.
Manual: You must manually replace faulty hosts
HostReplacePolicy.description_zh:
主机故障时系统的处理策略。返回值：
Auto：自动替换主机。
Manual：手动替换主机

InstanceNumber.description_en: The total number of instances in the dedicated cluster
InstanceNumber.description_zh: 当前专属集群中实例的总个数

MemAllocateRation.description_en: The percentage of allocated memory space in the dedicated cluster. Unit: %
MemAllocateRation.description_zh: 当前专属集群已分配的内存比例。单位：百分号（%）

MemAllocatedAmount.description_en: The amount of allocated memory space in the dedicated cluster
MemAllocatedAmount.description_zh: 当前专属集群中已分配的内存数量

MemAllocationRatio.description_en: The memory overcommitment ratio of the dedicated cluster. Unit: %. For more information about the core overcommitment ratio, see [Manage a dedicated cluster]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/182328.html）
MemAllocationRatio.description_zh: 当前专属集群的内存超配比。单位：%。关于超配比的更多信息，请参见[管理集群]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/182328.html）

MemUsedAmount.description_en: The amount of used memory space in the dedicated cluster. Unit: MB
MemUsedAmount.description_zh: 当前专属集群中已使用的内存数量。单位：MB

MemUtility.description_en: The memory usage of the dedicated cluster. Unit: %
MemUtility.description_zh: 当前专属集群的内存利用率。单位：百分号（%）

OpenPermission.description_en:
Indicates whether the feature that allows you to have the OS permissions on the host is enabled. Valid values:

0 or null: The permissions cannot be granted.
1: The permissions can be granted.
3: The permissions have been granted
OpenPermission.description_zh:
主机OS权限开放状态。返回值：
0或者null：不可开放。
1：可开放。
3：已开放

Text.description_en: The name and ID of the dedicated cluster. The value consists of DedicatedHostGroupDesc and DedicatedHostGroupId. Format: DedicatedHostGroupDesc/DedicatedHostGroupId
Text.description_zh: 当前专属集群的名称和ID信息。由DedicatedHostGroupDesc和DedicatedHostGroupId拼接，格式为：DedicatedHostGroupDesc/DedicatedHostGroupId

VPCId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the dedicated cluster belongs
VPCId.description_zh: 当前专属集群所在专有网络VPC ID

ZoneIDList.description_en: The zones to which the hosts of the dedicated cluster belong
ZoneIDList.description_zh: 当前专属集群主机所在的可用区列表

items.description_en: The zones to which the hosts of the dedicated cluster belong
items.description_zh: 当前专属集群主机所在的可用区列表
